name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
February 2, 2009
09:30 A.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Dever
d.
Roll Call
2.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of Certificates of Recognition for outstanding contributions to the Lomita business
community: Albertsons, A-1 Coast Rentals, Big Lots, California Pro Sports, Carl’s Jr Restaurant,
Cycle Gear, Inc, CVS Pharmacy, Thompson Building Materials, Lomita Mobil, Ace Shell and 99
Cent Store.
Presentation of city plaque to former Parks & Recreation Commissioner Gary Anderson for his
services 1996-2008.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are
not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to
placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do
so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for
the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established.
Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in
discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one
motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council
votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any
Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: January 5
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report submitting October and November 2008 Treasury and Investment Report.
RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting progress report for public works projects. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report submitting Ordinance No 722 which amends Title 12 Chapter 4 of the Municipal
Code dealing with drought conservation and water management and retrofit requirements for
non-water saving plumbing fixtures in residential and commercial properties. RECOMMEND
APPROVAL.
i.
Report recommending award of bid to Golden State Water Company and Chandler Palos
Verdes Sand & Gravel for the lease of water rights for 2008-09. RECOMMEND
APPROVAL.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
6.
REVENUE SHORTFALL Discussion and possible action on revenue shortfall.
Presented by Adm Svcs Drtc Chavez.
CLOSED SESSION
Conference with legal counsel - anticipated litigation (Govt Code 54956.9(b)) No. of potential
cases: 1
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
